notes.title: Girls Overboard is Delayed
notes.content:
"How do you make God laugh? …Tell him your plans." - John Cleese

Even though this is only our 2nd game release, we really thought we could do it. Despite a major setback that caused us to lose an entire week of development time, we didn't give up but instead pulled some all-nighters (mainly our programmer, Bam. He really pulled through) and WE FINISHED THE GAME!

Then came the Steam review process... Since we did everything on our end to comply with Steam's terms (NSFW Rules), we had hoped we would be approved. We even based the review time on an earlier review and made plans to have time to submit again if needed. This is why we decided to move forward with the original launch timeline. However, the review time by Steam took much longer than previously and we lost all that extra submission time.

It was a gamble waiting for approval until the actual day of launch, but the last thing I wanted to do was write this. As team leader (Din), I take full responsibility for the delay and sincerely apologize. My team has done everything on our end possible to meet today's deadline, but now it is in the hands of the Steam Review team.

We do not have an exact timeframe (hopefully next week!) on getting approved by Steam Review. As soon as we have any new information, I will share it on Discord and here. Please know we are doing everything within our power to get you to Kawaii Island so you can romance those beautiful babes! 💦


In the meantime, thankfully, we can finally show off the full thing for everyone to see – 
Check out the full version of the launch video on our YouTube channel ☀️
At the link below:
 [previewyoutube=-opyRLyi5zg;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your patience. Again, this is my fault and I apologize. I want to make an awesome game for you and I want to release it! 

-Din

using pearls will be OPTIONAL. 

You will NOT need to purchase anything in-game in order to complete relationships and unlock all the steamy Wet 'n' Wild scenes.

We want to emphasize once again, the SFW version of Girls Overboard will be FREE to play. 
The team and I are basing this price on one of our favorite puzzle games, Mirror. Since we are only a three-person studio and this is our first (full-on H) game, we want Girls Overboard to gain as much attention as possible. What better way than to make it only $1.99!? 

💦 Steam Demo: 
Like a drug-addicted friend, Girls Overboard has changed a lot since you last saw it. But unlike drug addiction, it changed for the better! The main reason development has taken so long is that through player feedback we have changed the gameplay into a Match-3 game!

All content will be available on itchio and our website! Whether you want to buy the game DRM free or just get the NSFW patch from outside of Steam, we will have you covered. Look forward to specific details in a future post!

All the in-game artwork is completed! Each story scene will reflect the relationship status and escalate towards a climax (literally and figuratively). We are just putting User Interface at 90% because we may add visual effects, resize or tweak some menus based on final testing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/d8466a4a05f9cb3cfefefb9ca194e0636ebc2eec.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/6173554bfa9f547aec2f59fcd8c7784ab5f52271.png
We have tons of different outfits that will not only give a variety of appearances to your favorite girls but depending on their rarity will also give you a stamina regeneration bonus. Five Star outfits will be 18+ and only available in the Wet 'n' Wild DLC patch of Girls Overboard!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/363d913ee96855a1f67fa8941e893afb209d85b8.jpg
There are already several girls lined up to join the datable roster of Girls Overboard as post-launch DLC. Some are native to Kawaii while some are familiar faces from far-off places!

Release Window
Girls Overboard development has taken longer than we originally planned, but the main reason for that was the decision to completely revamp the core gameplay into a Match-3 game. This was a decision we hope you will understand as it has made Girls Overboard more enjoyable to play. If you played the first demo, we're sure you will agree!

After careful consideration of the amount of work left to do, we have decided on a release date window of April 5th - April 15th, 2022. This will give us enough time to finalize the remaining tasks and pass the Steam review process.

We will be releasing another update between March 14th - March 18th, 2022 that will include a new trailer, and the exact release date.

Game Information and Pricing
At launch, Girls Overboard will be available only on Steam for PC. 
After release, we will work on making GO available via our website and other platforms. As well as localization/translations and a Mac version if possible.

The SFW version of Girls Overboard will be FREE to play. The 18+ Wet 'n' Wild version will be available as a DLC patch for only $1.99.

Closing Note
We hope that everyone is excited for their Kawaii vacation and we ask for your patience just a little longer as we finish development. Thank you for supporting a new studio like us. We look forward to sharing a bright future of games with you and we'll be back with another update next week!

If you have any questions, please email us at AGLstudioArt@gmail.com or join our discord: https://discord.gg/AGLstudioArt

notes.title: Girls Overboard Coming to Steam Game Festival!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Girls Overboard will be in the Steam Game Festival! 
Wishlist Girls Overboard on Steam!

Starting Feb 3rd, you'll be able to play the Girls Overboard Demo! We couldn't be more excited to share the alpha version of our latest game. In fact, we are so excited, that we've decided that players who complete the demo will be awarded a bonus item pack in the full game. This bonus item pack will either give you a head start or an ace up your sleeve!

However, we are too hyped to wait for Feb. 3rd, so... Knight Tier+ Patreon supporters will have early access to the demo! We hope you play it and give us all the feedback you can. We want Girls Overboard to be the best game it can be! Leading up to the Steam Game Festival you can expect massive amounts of art updates!
